name: WooCommerce first-sale readiness
description: Pre-launch shop check: payment gateway live, shipping zone present, tax class sane, first product complete, welcome coupon tested, order pipeline dry-run.

steps.title: Payments
steps.detail: Call wc_list_payment_gateways and confirm at least one enabled gateway with a completed setup; report the checkout path for the owner.

steps.title: Shipping
steps.detail: Call wc_list_shipping_zones (or create one with wc_create_shipping_zone + wc_create_shipping_method when the owner agrees) and verify the home country is covered.

steps.title: Taxes
steps.detail: Call wc_list_tax_classes (create with wc_create_tax_class + wc_create_tax_rate on confirmation) and verify prices-entered-with-tax matches the owner's intent.

steps.title: First product
steps.detail: Call wc_get_product on the hero product (or wc_create_product when none exists): verify price, stock status, description and image; fix with wc_update_product on confirmation.

steps.title: Welcome coupon
steps.detail: Call wc_create_coupon (or wc_get_coupon to verify) for a first-order discount; confirm restrictions (email, usage limit) with the owner.

steps.title: Order pipeline
steps.detail: Call wc_get_orderable_statuses and wc_list_email_notifications: verify statuses and the customer/admin notification emails are enabled, then wc_test_email if available for the shop email.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver a go/no-go checklist with the exact gaps left.

guardrails: Never touch live orders or existing coupons during a readiness check.
Gateway credentials are never read back or echoed: report enabled/disabled only.
